column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_throw.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Runs the module's registered destructor chain: while the list head 0x000188a0 is non-NULL, unlinks the first node {next, function, argument} and calls function(argument, -1) (hypothesis: compiler-generated static-destructor runner, confidence medium; no code read here adds nodes). No return value. Side effects: empties 0x000188a0, plus whatever the destructors do. Registered (through a thunk) as the scene end callback by world_throw_module_entry; no direct caller.

column2: void world_throw_run_global_constructors(void *begin, void *end, void *table, int table_end)
column3: Calls every function pointer in the array [begin, end), then registers table/table_end with world_throw_register_static_table. The only caller passes the empty range 0x0001875e..0x0001875e and the pair 0x00018890/0x00018890, so no constructor runs (hypothesis: compiler start-up routine, confidence medium). No return value. Side effects: the slot table 0x000188a4. Callers: 1 (world_throw_static_init).

Pointer-to-member-function call thunk (old GCC layout). The member-pointer descriptor arrives in t9 (not a normal argument): word +0 delta, word +4 index, word +8 function. It adds delta to object (a0); when index is negative it jumps to the function word directly; otherwise it treats word +8 as the offset of the vtable pointer inside the adjusted object and jumps to *(*(object + word8) + index), i.e. a virtual call. Arguments a1-t3 pass through unchanged and the target's return value is returned. Side effects: those of the called member. No direct jal caller: reached by the tail jump in world_throw_actor_draw (0x00006544, t9 = actor + 0x2c).

Finds the first free entry (word 0 == 0) of the 16-entry, 8-byte table 0x000188a4 and stores start at +0 and end - 0xc at +4; returns the entry index, or -1 when all 16 are used (hypothesis: frame/exception table registration emitted by the compiler, confidence medium). Side effects: 0x000188a4..0x00018923. Callers: 1 (world_throw_run_global_constructors).

Jump thunk (8 bytes: j 0x00000000; nop) to world_throw_run_global_destructors. Arguments, return value and side effects are those of world_throw_run_global_destructors (documented in docs/subsystems/functions/world.md). No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Calls world_throw_run_global_constructors(0x0001875e, 0x0001875e, 0x00018890, 0x00018890): an empty constructor range plus one table registration. No return value. Side effects: the table 0x000188a4. Callers: 1 (world_throw_scene_main).

column2: void world_throw_draw_actor_sheet_sprite(void *list, void *tex_odd, void *tex_even, float *pos, int direction, int move_state, int frame)
column3: Draws a single-sheet character (characters without a field model): binds tex_even for directions 0/2/4/6 and tex_odd for 1/3/5/7 (field_3d_gim_emit_texture), enables blending (0, 2, 3), alpha test (6, 0, 0xff), texture function (0, 1) and nearest filtering, then draws one 0x33 x 0x54 sprite at (pos[0], pos[1]) whose uv pair comes from the table 0x0000f138 (move_state 1) or 0x0000f130 (move_state 0) + frame * 8 + (direction / 2) * 0x38. Arguments 5-7 travel in t0-t2. No return value. Side effects: display-list output. Callers: 1 (world_throw_actor_draw_sheet).

column2: void world_throw_draw_actor_parts(void *list, void *upper_tex, int cell_id, int upper_clut, void *lower_tex, int lower_clut, float *pos, int direction, int move_state, int frame)
column3: Draws a field-model character in two parts using world_get_character_sprite_cell(direction, cell_id, move_state, frame): the lower part (0x33 x 0x40) from lower_tex with palette lower_clut at y + 16, then the upper part (0x33 x 0x32) from upper_tex with palette upper_clut raised by the returned offset, both mirrored by the returned flag; sets blending (0, 2, 3), alpha test and nearest filtering first. Arguments 5-8 travel in t0-t3, 9-10 on the stack. No return value. Side effects: display-list output. Callers: 1 (world_throw_actor_draw_model).

column2: void world_get_character_sprite_cell(int *out_u, int *out_v, int *out_offset, int *out_u2, int *out_v2, int *out_flip, int direction, int cell_id, int move_state, int frame)
column3: Same code as the rel_field function: maps direction 0-7 to a sheet column and mirror flag (0 -> 2, 1 -> 0, 2 -> 3, 3 -> 1, 4 -> 4, 5 -> 1 mirrored, 6 -> 3 mirrored, 7 -> 0 mirrored), returns the cell (column * 0x33 + 0xff when cell_id % 10 >= 5, (cell_id % 10 % 5) * 0x32), the lower-part uv from this module's tables 0x0000f210 (move_state 0) / 0x0000f218 (move_state 1) + frame * 8 + column * 0x38, the signed offset byte of 0x0000f330 + column * 7 + frame (+1 when walking; direction is returned for other move states) and the mirror flag. Arguments 9-10 on the stack. No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (world_throw_draw_actor_parts).

Clears a 0x150-byte menu context and stores heap (the caller passes the bound mini_result archive) in its first word. No return value. Side effects: writes ctx. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_create). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_init.

column2: ushort * ui_throw_menu_ctx_get_message(void *ctx, int table_base, int table_offset, uint index)
column3: Returns string index of a mini_result message table: gets member name number table_base + table_offset (ui_throw_menu_ctx_get_message_table_name; callers pass 0 + save language) and looks it up in the archive held in the context's first word (ui_throw_get_archive_dictionary_word). No side effects. Callers: 3 (ui_throw_result_handle_input, ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_number, ui_throw_result_draw_labels). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_get_message.

Copies the 0x240-byte name array 0x0000fb20 (0x12 names of 0x20 bytes, mini_result_j.bin first) to the stack and, when index < 0x12, copies name index into out. Returns index < 0x12. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_menu_ctx_get_message). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_get_message_table_name.

Finds member in the EHP archive (container_ehp_find_member) and returns string index of that string table (card_db_get_dictionary_word; the decompiler drops the return value). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_menu_ctx_get_message). Copy of the rel_title function ui_get_archive_dictionary_word.

Copies the 0x140-byte name array 0x0000fd60 (0x40-byte names, result_mini01.gim first, 5 entries) and returns member index of the context's archive (container_ehp_find_member). No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_menu_ctx_bind_image). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_find_image.

Caches image index of the context (ui_throw_menu_ctx_find_image) at ctx + 0x13c + index * 4. No return value. Side effects: writes the context. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_init). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_bind_image.

Returns the cached image pointer at ctx + 0x13c + index * 4. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_throw_result_draw_panels, ui_throw_result_draw_header). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_get_image.

column2: void ui_throw_menu_ctx_bind_layout(void *ctx, int index, int mode, int start, int end)
column3: Looks up layout index of the context's archive by name (0x180-byte array 0x0000fea0 of 0x40-byte names, m_menu_bar01.ehf first), stores it at ctx + 0x124 + index * 4 and sets its play range (ui_throw_menu_ctx_set_layout_range). Argument 5 travels in t0. No return value. Side effects: the context, the layout player. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_init). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_bind_layout.

column2: void ui_throw_menu_ctx_set_layout_range(void *ctx, int index, int mode, int start, int end)
column3: Sets the play range of context layout index (ctx + 0x124 + index * 4) when bound: modes 1 and 2 play start..end (ui_ehf_set_play_range(start, end + 1)), mode 0 holds start. Argument 5 travels in t0. No return value. Side effects: the layout player. Callers: 4 (ui_throw_result_update_message_window, ui_throw_menu_ctx_bind_layout, ui_throw_result_handle_input, ui_throw_result_wait_intro). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_set_layout_range.

Returns the current frame of context layout index (ui_ehf_get_current_frame), or -1 when unbound. No side effects. Callers: 2 (ui_throw_result_poll_layout, ui_throw_result_wait_intro). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_get_layout_frame.

Draws context layout index when bound: zeroed 0x60-byte parameter block with the frame timing value in word 0, ui_ehf_draw between ui_ehf_begin_draw and ui_ehf_end_draw. Returns the advanced display list (list unchanged when unbound). Side effects: the display list, the player. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_draw). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_draw_layout.

Resets a list window (ui_list_window_reset, clears 0x120 bytes) and fills the default message-box descriptor: type 1, position (0x27, 0xe0), size 0x191 x 0x2e, margins 0xc/0xc/6/6, font sizes 0xd, colours -1, +0xac/+0xb0 = 2, heap at +0xc4, option bits +0xc8..+0xf2. No return value. Side effects: the window. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_menu_ctx_open_message_window). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_reset_window.

column2: void ui_throw_menu_ctx_open_message_window(void *heap, void *window, ushort *text, int choices, int modal)
column3: Opens a message window: default descriptor, type 2, position (0x3c, 100), size 0x168 x 0x50, margins 10/10/8/0, text at +0x84, +0x60 = 1 when modal, flag bit 5 of +0xc8; choices 1 configures one choice, choices 0 three; then ui_open_list_window. Argument 5 travels in t0. No return value. Side effects: the window. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_handle_input). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_open_message_window.

Draws a list window (ui_draw_list_window), first centring it on the 480 x 272 screen (+0x58 = (0x1e0 - width) / 2, +0x5a = (0x110 - height) / 2) when centre is set. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, the window position. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_draw). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_draw_window.

column2: void * ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_panel_part(void *list, int image, int part, short x, short y, int width, int height)
column3: Draws part from the 4-halfword (u, v, w, h) table 0x00010020 at (x, y) at its own size (ui_duel_result_draw_atlas_rect); for parts 1-9 also a 0x40 x 0x40 inset piece at (x + 3, y + 3) with u = 0x48 + (part - 1) * 4. image, width and height are not used. Arguments 5-7 travel in t0-t2. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 2 (ui_throw_result_draw_panels, ui_throw_result_draw_header). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_draw_panel_part.

column2: void * ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_nine_slice(void *list, int kind, int colour, short x, short y, short width, short height)
column3: Draws a nine-slice box of width x height at (x, y) from the 9 x 4-halfword part table 0x000100b8: the colour selects the texture offset (kind 2: colours from 0xc, u = ((c - 0xc) % 6) * 10, v = ((c - 0xc) / 6) * 10; kind 0: u = (c % 6) * 10 + 0x17, v = (c / 6) * 10, colour 8 at (0, 0x74)); corners at their size, edges and centre stretched to width - 9 / height - 9. Arguments 5-7 in t0-t2. Returns the advanced display list (the decompiler shows none). Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_draw_panels). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_draw_nine_slice.

column2: void * ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_border_box(void *list, int kind, int colour, short x, short y, short width, short height)
column3: Draws a thin nine-slice border box from the part table 0x00010100 (pieces at x, x + 2, x + width - 3 and y, y + 2, y + height - 3; middle pieces stretched to width - 5 / height - 5). kind and colour are not used. Returns the advanced display list (the decompiler shows none). Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_draw_panels). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_draw_border_box.

column2: void * ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_three_slice_bar(void *list, int kind, int colour, short x, short y, short width)
column3: Draws a horizontal three-piece bar from the part table 0x00010148 (v + 0x17): left cap at x, middle at x + 6 stretched to width - 0xb, right cap at x + width - 5, all at y. kind and colour are not used. Returns the advanced display list (the decompiler shows none). Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_draw_panels). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_draw_three_slice_bar.

Resets the GE state for 2D sprites: clear colour/depth/stencil 0, enables states 9 and 1, texture function (0, 1), white ambient, nearest filtering, disables 1 and 10, enables 4 with blend function (0, 2, 3) and white colour. The decompiler shows no return value; callers use the advanced list (hypothesis, medium). Side effects: the display list. Callers: 2 (ui_throw_result_draw_panels, ui_throw_result_draw_header).

column2: void * ui_duel_result_draw_atlas_rect(void *list, short x, short y, short w, short h, short u, short v, short tex_w, short tex_h, short flip_x, short flip_y)
column3: Draws one sprite from the bound atlas: system_ge_set_sprite_extent(list, tex_w, tex_h, w, h) and system_ge_draw_sprite_flipped at (x, y) with texel origin (u, v) and the two flip flags (arguments 9-11 on the stack). The decompiler shows no return value; callers chain the advanced list (hypothesis, medium). Side effects: the display list. Callers: 4 (ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_panel_part, ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_three_slice_bar, ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_nine_slice, ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_border_box).

column2: void * ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_text(void *list, int align, ushort *text, short x, short y, short width, uint color, short scale_x, short scale_y)
column3: Draws text in an external font list with colour and scale: align 0 at (x, y), align 1 centred in width (system_font_measure_string); other values draw nothing. Printing is done by ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit_1898(x, y, width, text). Arguments 5-8 in t0-t3, 9 on the stack. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 2 (ui_throw_result_draw_labels, ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_number). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_draw_text.

column2: void ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit_1898(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper (Ghidra shows an empty body; read from the twin): system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). Side effects: those of system_font_draw_text_fit_width (text drawn). Callers: 1 (ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_text).

column2: void * ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_number(void *list, void *ctx, int table_base, int table_offset, int glyph_base, int mode, uint value, uint min_digits, int align, short x, short y, short width, uint color, short scale_x, short scale_y)
column3: Draws a number with one mini_result string per digit (glyph_base + digit via ui_throw_menu_ctx_get_message): mode 0 as many digits as value needs (at least min_digits), mode 1 exactly min_digits, laid out right to left with step min(width / digits, scale_x); mode 2 a time in hundredths of a second (centiseconds, seconds % 60, minutes % 60, hours) with separator strings glyph_base - 5 at half step. Arguments 9-15 on the stack. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_draw_values). Copy of the rel_title function ui_menu_ctx_draw_number.

column2: void ui_throw_result_create(void *heap, void *archive, int game, uint *score)
column3: Allocates the 0x2c4-byte result block from heap (pointer in 0x00018924), stores heap at +0, initialises its menu context at +0x54 with archive, stores game at +0x20, applies the score when given (ui_throw_result_apply_score) and initialises the screen (ui_throw_result_init). rel_throw passes game 6 and the score word 0x00018bc0. No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, 0x00018924, the save (through apply_score). Callers: 1 (world_throw_update).

When the result block 0x00018924 exists, resets its list window (+0x1a4, ui_list_window_reset), frees it on its heap and clears the pointer. No return value. Side effects: heap free, 0x00018924. Callers: 2 (world_throw_update, world_throw_game_term).

Scores a finished mini-game into the result block 0x00018924 and the save, same logic as the rel_title copy: stores score values (+0x28/+0x2c/+0x40) and the main score into world_get_minigame_score(); base DP (+0x30) per game (0: score / 50, 1: / 150, 2: / 2 plus ceil(sub / 100), 3: / 10, 4: score[1] * 20 + score[2] * 150, 5: / 50, 6: / 10); each new record (save_get/set_minigame_record_0..8) adds 200 bonus DP (+0x34), sets the new-record flags (+0x44/+0x46) and a marker byte in the save record table (+0xec + record); total +0x38, experience +0x3c = total / 25; save_add_dp, save_add_duelist_exp and 400 more DP on a level up; games 3 and 4 also store the from-story flag (+0x1c). rel_throw uses game 6 (record 8, marker byte +0xf4). No return value. Side effects: the result block, save records, DP, experience, the world score. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_create).

Binds the result screen's context layouts (0: frames 0..0x10, 1: 0..0x1df) and images 0 and 1, sets step +0xc = 1 and starts a 16-frame black fade in. No return value. Side effects: the result block, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_create).
Returns ui_throw_result_update_main() when the block's mode word +8 is 0, otherwise 1. Side effects: through the update. Callers: 1 (world_throw_update).

Step handler of the result screen (+0xc): 2 waits for the intro, 3 handles input, 4 updates the message window, 5 polls layout 0, 6 returns the outcome +0x24 (2 = play again, 3 = quit; medium); steps 0/1 wait for the fade. Returns 1 while running, 0 for unknown steps. Side effects: through the handlers. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_update).

Step 2: when context layout 0 reaches frame 0x10 switches it to the loop 0x11..0x60; from frame 0x10 on sets step 3. No return value. Side effects: the layout, step. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_update_main).

Step 3: on a face button (ui_throw_result_poll_face_buttons): when launched from the story (+0x1c == 1) sets outcome 3, fades the BGM out (600), plays layout 0 frames 0x61..0x65, step 5 and a black fade out; otherwise step 4, outcome 3 and opens a modal three-choice message window with mini_result string 0xd at +0x1a4. No return value. Side effects: the block, window, BGM, fade. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_update_main).
True when any face button (pad pressed bits 0xf000) was pressed, playing sound 0x7a05. Side effects: sound. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_handle_input).

Step 4: updates the window +0x1a4; result 2 sets outcome +0x24 = 2, 3 or -2 sets 3; when the window state byte +0x28d is 6 plays layout 0 frames 0x36..0x65, sets step 5, fades out and fades the BGM (600). No return value. Side effects: the block, layout, fade, BGM. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_update_main).

Tail-jumps to the layout-frame getter on layout 0 of the context (a0 = context + 0x54, a1 = 0), so it returns that frame; the decompiler drops the jump and shows nothing returned, and the caller ignores the value. Copy of the rel_title routine ui_mini_result_is_layout_frame_101 without its compare with 0x65. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_update_main).

Draws the result screen: context layout 1, layout 0 from step 2, the header, panels and labels/values, the message window centred at step 4; drives the fades (step 5 -> 6 and step 1 -> 2 when system_draw_fade finishes). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, step. Callers: 1 (world_throw_draw).

At steps 3 and 4, with context image 1 bound, resets the sprite state and draws its part 0xd at (0x70, 8). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_draw).

With context image 0 bound draws the result panels: border box (0x3e, 0x3d, 0x165 x 0xa4), two sections (y 0x40 and 0x79) each with a title bar and value box and two rows (label box 0x10d x 0x10 colour 3, value box 0x49 x 0x10 colour 1, new-record mark part 0xc at (0x14a, y + 3) in the first section when +0x44/+0x46 is set), two three-slice bars with value boxes at y 0xb3/0xc8 and the bottom bar (colour 8, y 0x100, 0x1e2 x 0x12). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_draw).

Draws the result texts from mini_result_<l>.bin: section titles 1/3 with value headers 2/5 (white, scale 0xe), row labels per game (first section: 4 for games 0, 1, 3, 5, 6; 6 and 7 for game 2; 0x13 and 0x14 for game 4, the second only when +0x40 is set; second section 8 and 9 with unit string 0xe in cyan 0xff00ffff), totals 10 and 11 with units 0xe/0xf, the centred footer 0xc at y 0x102, then the values (ui_throw_result_draw_values). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list, font state. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_draw).

Draws the six result values (+0x28..+0x3c of the block 0x00018924) right-aligned at x 0x155 with digit glyph strings from 0x15 (ui_throw_menu_ctx_draw_number, white, scale 0xe): rows at y 0x54/0x67, 0x8d/0xa0 and 0xb9/0xce; width 0x47 for the first pair, 0x33 for the others; at least 6 digits for the first two, 5 for the others; the second value only for games 2 (as a time, mode 2) and 4 (when +0x40 is set). Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_draw_labels). Copy of the rel_title function ui_mini_result_draw_values.

True when the mini-game scene (0x15 for game 4, 0x18 for game 3, 0 otherwise) was called from scene 2 (system_scene_get_caller); false when called from scene 0xd (the title) or anything else. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_throw_result_apply_score). Copy of the rel_title function ui_mini_result_is_from_story.

Searches the 140 rows of this module's copy of the character table 0x00010160 (57 words per row) for column 0 == character and returns the word at column column of that row; returns 0 when the character is not found. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_throw_partner_set_item_preference). Same code as the rel_story function.

Module entry point of rel_throw (scene 0x1c). Sets the current thread attribute (sceKernelChangeCurrentThreadAttr(0, 0x4000)) and, when arg is 0, registers the scene with system_scene_register(start world_throw_scene_main, end thunk of world_throw_run_global_destructors, data 0x00018928). Returns 0. Side effects: scene registration. No direct caller (module entry).

Scene start callback of scene 0x1c: runs world_throw_static_init, sets the thread attribute 0x4000, hides the loading overlay and initialises the game (world_throw_scene_init); then installs the frame callback (system_scene_set_frame_callback(2, world_throw_frame_callback, thunk of world_throw_game_term)), loops world_throw_scene_update + system_wait_frame until it reports completion, restores no-op callbacks, shows the loading overlay, waits a frame and returns to the caller with system_scene_return(0x1c, 0). The decompiler tests a return value of world_throw_scene_init that it shows as void. No return value. Side effects: scene callbacks, the whole game. Registered as the scene start callback by world_throw_module_entry.

Reads the five words of the throw parameter block (world_get_throw_params: partner character, variant, word 2, word 3, word 4) and passes them to world_throw_game_init, then sets the draw-enable flag 0x00018934 = 1. No return value (see world_throw_scene_main). Side effects: everything world_throw_game_init sets, 0x00018934. Callers: 1 (world_throw_scene_main).

Runs one frame of world_throw_update; when it returns non-zero clears the draw-enable flag 0x00018934. Returns true when the game has finished. Side effects: those of world_throw_update, 0x00018934. Callers: 1 (world_throw_scene_main).

Frame callback: calls world_throw_draw while the draw-enable flag 0x00018934 is set. (The pack's twin line to rel_duel_draw ui_duel_draw_frame_if_active is a false positive: same shape, different callee.) No return value. Side effects: those of world_throw_draw. No direct caller (installed by world_throw_scene_main with system_scene_set_frame_callback).

Jump thunk (8 bytes: j 0x000040a4; nop) to world_throw_game_term. Arguments, return value and side effects are those of world_throw_game_term (documented in docs/subsystems/functions/world.md). No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

Updates a list window (ui_update_list_window) and, once it reports a result other than -1, resets it (ui_list_window_reset). Returns the window result (-1 while open, else the choice or -2 for cancel). Side effects: the window. Callers: 1 (world_throw_state_update_window).
Draws a list window with ui_draw_list_window(&list, window) and returns the advanced display list. Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (world_throw_draw).

Writes the per-frame GE state of the 3D layer: offset (0x710, 0x778), viewport centre (0x800, 0x800) size 480 x 272, depth range 0xffff..0, blend (0, 2, 3), disables 4, scissor 480 x 272, enables 2, alpha test (6, 0, 0xff), enables 0, depth function 7, enables 1, front face 1, enables 5 and 9, smooth shading, enables 8, white colour, fog 50.0..100.0 colour 0x404040, disables 7, clear colour 0xff000000 / depth 0 / stencil 0, clear 0x17, linear filtering, white ambient, lighting on and light 0 off. The decompiler shows no return value; the caller uses the advanced list (hypothesis, medium). Side effects: the display list. Callers: 1 (world_throw_draw).
